mechanism: Valproic acid inhibits brivaracetam metabolism via CYP2C19 and UGT, increasing brivaracetam exposure; brivaracetam may displace valproic acid from protein binding, increasing free valproic acid levels.
action: Monitor for increased brivaracetam adverse effects (CNS depression, behavioral changes); consider brivaracetam dose reduction if co-administered; monitor valproic acid levels as displacement may increase toxicity risk.
